# archestra_chatops_ms_teams (Resource)

The organization's Microsoft Teams integration, so people can chat with agents in Teams. One per organization. The app secret is write-only: the API never returns it, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. Destroying the resource turns the integration off and keeps the stored credentials. Enabling it checks the credentials with Microsoft Entra ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "teams_app_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "archestra_chatops_ms_teams" "this" {
  app_id     = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  tenant_id  = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  app_secret = var.teams_app_secret
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) Microsoft Entra application (client) ID of the bot.
- `app_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret of the bot's application.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the integration is on.
- `group_chat_file_sign_in` (Boolean) Whether people sign in to share files from group chats.
- `tenant_id` (String) Microsoft Entra tenant ID.

### Read-Only

- `configured` (Boolean) Whether the stored configuration is complete.
- `id` (String) Integration name.
- `sign_in_redirect_uri` (String) Redirect URI to register on the application for sign-in.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the configuration was last saved.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_chatops_ms_teams.this ms-teams
```
